title: ALLROUND4YOU
tagline: A one-page site that turns a WhatsApp-only contractor into a business people can research before they call.
summary: A Dutch construction business with 20+ years of experience had no website — every relationship started cold on WhatsApp. JOMO built a single page the owner could send as a link.
role: End-to-end: IA, design, content, development, domain and hosting
timeline: About 20 calendar days, including client feedback cycles
coverImageAlt: Renovated open-plan kitchen with exposed timber ceiling beams and pendant lighting, part of ALLROUND4YOU's completed work
problem: The owner had 20+ years of experience but no way to show it. Every relationship started cold on WhatsApp, with nothing to send a prospect before they decided whether to call.
solution: A single, well-organized page rather than a multi-page site — enough to build trust in under a minute. It covers all twelve service categories, a real project gallery, and direct call/WhatsApp actions. Built end-to-end — IA, design, content, development, domain and hosting — through six client revision rounds.
outcome: Delivered in about 20 days including feedback cycles. The client was satisfied and said he'd recommend JOMO to other contacts.
